articles.summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, today announced the appointment of Mark Stewart to its Board of Directors as an independent director. “Mark is a proven global leader with deep experience across the automotive, manufacturing, technology, and consumer sectors,” said Rick Burdick, Chairman of the AutoNation Board of Directors. “His strategic perspective, operational discipline, and track record of leading complex organizations through transformation will strengthen the Board as we continue to advance AutoNation’s strategy and deliver long-term value for our shareholders.” Mr. Stewart has served as Chief Executive Officer and President of The Goodyear Tire Rubber Company and as a member of its Board of Directors since January 2024. articles.title: AutoNation Appoints Mark Stewart to Board of Directors

articles.summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN) today announced the appointment of Ravi Simhambhatla as Chief Technology and AI Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Mr. Simhambhatla will lead the Company’s technology, data science, and AI agenda. Ravi Simhambhatla joins AutoNation as Chief Technology and AI Officer "Over decades, we have built a portfolio of brands, physical infrastructure, and scale that have delivered consistently strong returns for our shareholders, and that would be nearly impossible to replicate today," said Mike Manley, Chief Executive Officer of AutoNation. "Technology, data science, and the intelligent use of AI give us the opportunity to get significantly more from that foundation: to raise the returns on our capital and extend our reach well beyond traditional geographic boundaries. articles.title: AutoNation Appoints Ravi Simhambhatla Chief Technology and AI Officer

articles.summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Friday, October 30, 2026, before the market opens. AutoNation management will discuss these results and other information regarding the Company during a conference call and audio webcast that same day at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The conference call may be accessed by telephone at 833-461-5787 (Conference ID: 561396341) or on AutoNation’s investor relations website at investors.autonation.com . The webcast will also be made available on AutoNation’s website following the call under “Events Presentations.” About AutoNation, Inc. AutoNation, one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offers innovative products and exceptional services as part of a portfolio of comprehensive solutions for our customers and their automotive needs.
